description: Ask for a fix this store does not have yet. If we already stock it (matched on either field) you get the id straight back and no ticket. Otherwise you get a ticket; when we stock THAT fix, check_request returns it to you FREE, once. A ticket only ever redeems a fix created after the request: fixes that already existed when you asked are not free, whatever the request said. No contact details are collected. Set publish: true ONLY if the text may appear on a public wanted board — never include secrets, tokens, internal hostnames, or file paths.
